prerequisite: PALMER_ISLAND_PARTITION_OVERLAP_V1 primary result: positive within-minus-between colony-growth correlation contrast under the frozen missingness-aware estimator
purpose: Test whether the positive island-partition contrast is driven by any single island, especially the locally extinct Litchfield series.

procedure.estimator: exactly the frozen overlap V1 Fisher-z weighted within-minus-between colony-growth correlation contrast
procedure.null: within each omitted-island subset, permute remaining island labels within five fixed mean-log1p-abundance rank strata
procedure.seed_rule: 20260927 + omission index in the fixed CHR,COR,HUM,LIT,TOR order

decisions.directional_robustness: all five leave-one-island-out contrasts must remain > 0
decisions.strong_permutation_robustness: all five leave-one-island-out two-sided permutation p-values must be <= 0.05
decisions.interpretation: failure of strong robustness does not erase the frozen primary result, but prevents claiming that the partition signal is geographically distributed across the Palmer panel

boundaries: No island will be selected or excluded based on its result.
No alternative correlation estimator, overlap threshold, abundance strata or permutation scheme will be opened.
This is a post-positive robustness diagnostic, not independent replication.
